data.name: Helpdesk: SLA Breach Sweep
data.description: Marks ongoing tbl.helpdesk_sla_status rows whose deadline has passed as failed (§4).

data.name: Helpdesk: Auto-Close Stale Tickets
data.description: Moves stale non-closed tickets past a team's auto_close_days into its auto_close_stage_id or last stage (§4).

data.name: Helpdesk: Close Inactive Tickets
data.description: Per-team warning/closing sweep of tickets past inactive_days_limit_warning/_closing (§9.6).

data.name: Helpdesk: Daily KPI Digest
data.description: Snapshots every team's tickets-closed/SLA-success-rate/avg-rating over the last 24 hours into tbl.helpdesk_digest_log.
